body: Got apps2/server-go running under systemd for the first time, fixed a real UDP port conflict with SHANKPIT (shank_server was already on :6969, moved server-go to a configurable -udp-port, deployed on :6970), and live-verified /chunks now serves real Meadow block+tree data. Separately, confirmed the founder's emilyspringerton/dragonfly fork is a genuine, unmodified fork of the real df-mc/dragonfly Bedrock server library -- built and ran it vanilla, real RakNet listener on :19132, mc-version=1.26.30, connectable from a real phone Minecraft client today for debug purposes. Amended SMOOTH_TERRAIN_NORTHSTAR.md with these findings (Trees, Town<->Dragonfly bridge, explicit out-of-scope notes).
title: Dragonfly backend: server-go supervised + Bedrock fork confirmed
